question: Which typical scenarios still attempt start positions that cannot match, and what do the leading-check jumps change?
candidate_commit: branch claude/regexp-performance-profiling-hao93x after 215ae5f (lazy Aho-Corasick build and line-jump condition included for the instruction counts)

environment.host: shared cloud VM, 4 vCPU Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, Linux x86_64
environment.noise_note: Wall-clock timings vary by up to about 15-25% between runs; small differences are judged by callgrind instruction counts.

method.matrix: Execution-profile harness plus 18 typical cases (t_*); tokens for t_valid_* are the whitespace-separated words of the corpus. Best of three interleaved rounds of at least 400 ms per case and build.
method.callgrind: One pass per case including process start, corpus load and compilation; total Ir. Measured after the lazy Aho-Corasick build; the timing rounds ran before it (search timing is unaffected: the automaton is built during warm-up).
method.scanner: Driver tokenizing the regression_scanner_documents inputs and the css_20 set line by line; search Ir per iteration = (Ir with N iterations - Ir without iterations) / N; setup Ir = grammar parsing plus Scanner compilation.

compile_cost_before_lazy_automaton: Building the Aho-Corasick automaton at compile time added 22% (Rust grammar) and 64% (css_20 set) to scanner setup instructions; building it on first use removed that.

validation.suites: cargo test --release (lib, compat_*, api_test) and --features match-cache pass; clippy -D warnings and rustfmt clean.
validation.unit_tests: src/leading_run.rs: plan and jump detection; exhaustive comparison with the original path now including (?i) prefixes, ^-led patterns, C* runs, \b runs, literal alternations, newline and malformed UTF-8 inputs and NOTBOL; generated expressions with these heads.
validation.mutations: Off-by-one jump target, line-start check without the previous-character-head rule, and a missing empty-C* attempt in the fallback path each fail the tests; the generated test found the last one during development.
validation.not_run: ffi differential against C Oniguruma (source download blocked in this environment).
